51830-mystery-of-the-ambush-in-india.creator: Unknown
51830-mystery-of-the-ambush-in-india.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. One was Kamuka, a Brazilian boy of Biff’s own size and age. They had met at the headwaters of the Amazon, where Biff had accompanied his father, Thomas Brewster, in an adventurous search for a fabulous gold mine. Kamuka, who had spent most of his life on jungle rivers, was keenly interested in the scenes he now was viewing along the Hooghly.

arxiv-2012-08649.title: Effect of right censoring bias on survival analysis
arxiv-2012-08649.creator: Enrique Barrajón, Laura Barrajón
arxiv-2012-08649.description: Abstract Kaplan-Meier survival analysis represents the most objective measure of treatment efficacy in oncology, though subjected to potential bias, which is worrisome in an era of precision medicine. Independent of the bias inherent to the design and execution of clinical trials, bias may be the result of patient censoring, or incomplete observation.

arxiv-2105-13019.title: An extension of the orthogonal derivative with adjustable precision
arxiv-2105-13019.creator: Enno Diekema
arxiv-2105-13019.description: Abstract The orthogonal derivative is defined as a limit of an integral whose kernel contains an orthogonal polynomial with its measure. When in practice no limit is taken, it means that the accuracy of the derivative depends on the second derivative of the given function.

arxiv-2210-13137.title: Maps to toric varieties and toric degenerations
arxiv-2210-13137.creator: Takuya Murata and Lara Bossinger
arxiv-2210-13137.description: Abstract . We study and construct maps to toric varieties. In the process, we generalize torus embeddings to the non-projective case. Moreover, we give an analog of Cox’s construction of toric varieties as GIT quotient of affine spaces for the non-normal case after T. Kajiwara.

arxiv-2401-16754.description: Abstract Powered by the increasing predictive capabilities of machine learning algorithms, artificial intelligence (AI) systems have the potential to overrule human mistakes in many settings. arxiv-2602-03058.title: Moments of sums of exponentials, beyond CHS
arxiv-2602-03058.creator: Silouanos Brazitikos, Colin Tang, Tomasz Tkocz
arxiv-2602-03058.description: Abstract We establish a sharp lower bound on the L p L_{p} -norm of sums of independent exponential random variables with fixed variance, for p ≥ 2 p\geq 2 , thus extending Hunter’s positivity theorem (1976) for completely homogeneous polynomials. We determine the exact regime of p p where such sums enjoy Schur-monotonicity. 2020 Mathematics Subject Classification.

pmc-11292406.title: Early detection of atrial fibrillation in the digital era, risk factors, treatment options, and the need for new definitions
pmc-11292406.creator: Renate B Schnabel, Daniel Engler, Ben Freedman
pmc-11292406.description:
A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Graphical abstract Graphical abstract

With the advances in digital technology and increasing awareness of the lifetime disease atrial fibrillation (AF) a better characterization and new understanding of the arrhythmia has emerged. The view of AF as a dichotomous disease and the largely artificial categorization into paroxysmal, persistent, and permanent require rethinking based on pathophysiology and clinical research in order to find a meaningful intersection with clinical medicine and management decisions.

pmc-11599936.creator: Helena Schulz-Mirbach, Philipp Wichmann, Ari Satanowski, Helen Meusel, Tong Wu, Maren Nattermann, Simon Burgener, Nicole Paczia, Arren Bar-Even, Tobias J. Erb
pmc-11599936.description: Acetyl-CoA is a key metabolic intermediate and the product of various natural and synthetic one-carbon (C1) assimilation pathways. pmc-11733912.title: Psychological distress and trajectories of sleep duration among Australian adolescents: a prospective cohort study

pmc-11733912.description: AbstractObjectivesThis study investigated the association between indicators of psychological distress and well-being and trajectories of sleep duration among a cohort of Australian adolescents.DesignA prospective cohort of adolescents was followed over 27 weeks (8 November 2019–14 May 2020). pmc-13340615.title: Associations between PTSD and psychotic symptoms: A network analysis of patients with psychotic disorders in Uganda: Psychosis-PTSD network analysis
pmc-13340615.creator: Hanseul Cho, Woohyung Lee, Hyungjun Park, Anne Stevenson, Daniel Bustamante, Rocky Elton Stroud, Shaili C. Jha, Joseph Kyebuzibwa, Allan Kalungi, Anita Arinda, Emmanuel K. Mwesiga, Raymond Rodokonyero, Akena Dickens, Manasi Sharma, Kristina J. Korte
pmc-13340615.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Introduction:Individuals with psychosis often endorse a history of trauma, yet the symptom-level interplay between trauma-related and psychotic symptoms is understudied globally and largely absent in Sub-Saharan Africa. We used network analysis to examine associations within and between these domains.Methods:We conducted a network analysis of 807 participants with a psychotic disorder and trauma history in the Ugandan cohort of the NeuroGAP-Psychosis program.

pmc-13652758.title: Dose-response, net clinical benefit and optimal dose ranges of stimulants in children and adolescents with ADHD: a network meta-analysis
pmc-13652758.creator: Yu Chang, Po-Chung Ju, Ming-Hong Hsieh, Yi-Chun Liu, Cheng-Chen Chang
pmc-13652758.description: Stimulant treatment with methylphenidate (MPH) and amphetamines (AMP) is first-line for children and adolescents with attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder (ADHD), but quantitative guidance on comparative efficacy and dose selection within licensed dose ranges remains limited. This study aimed to compare dose-response relationships for MPH and AMP and identify dose ranges that balance symptom improvement and adverse event-related discontinuation across benefit-risk preferences.

pmc-13680111.title: Adaptive drug resistance in melanoma is characterised by lipidome remodelling while maintaining cell membrane biophysical properties
pmc-13680111.creator: Aurélie H. Benfield, Reuben S. E. Young, Grégoire J. B. Philippe, Nicholas D. Condon, Nicolau Barbosa Palma Filho, Helmut Schaider, Stephen J. Blanksby, Sónia Troeira Henriques
pmc-13680111.description: Aim: Cancer drug resistance is driven by dynamic, systems-level adaptations, including cellular state transitions, epigenetic reprogramming, metabolic rewiring, and proteome remodelling. Lipid metabolic reprogramming is increasingly recognised as a contributor to resistance through alterations in the membrane composition and has been hypothesised to promote resistance by increasing membrane rigidity and limiting drug permeability.
